description: File detected conflicts and migration plans as initiative items in swarm-manager for human triage on scenarios the agent cannot complete autonomously.

requirements.description: Cartographer must file detected conflicts and migration plans as initiative items in swarm-manager for human triage when the agent determines it cannot complete the resolution autonomously. The integration must use swarm-manager's defined intake API and tag items with cartographer scenario context, conflict type, and severity. Items must not be duplicated if an identical conflict is already open in swarm-manager.
requirements.title: swarm-manager Backlog Integration for Unresolvable Conflicts

validation.notes: Deduplication logic: filing a conflict already present in swarm-manager updates the existing item rather than creating a duplicate
Initiative item payload includes scenario_id, conflict_id, conflict_type, severity, and suggested_fixes
End-to-end: arch-cart conflicts file --unresolvable against a fixture scenario creates initiative items in a swarm-manager test instance
Re-running the file command with the same conflicts does not create duplicate items in swarm-manager
Human reviewers in swarm-manager see all cartographer-unresolvable conflicts with enough context to triage without running cartographer themselves
Swarm-manager items are linked back to cartographer conflict IDs for traceability

title: swarm-manager Backlog Integration
